body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> The desk lamp for study professional enterprise Prism (representative Kim Seok-ho, www.prismlight.co.kr) is going to exhibit its products at 'CES(Consumer Electronics Show) 2011' held in Las Vegas, USA from Jan. 6~9.
Prism has a plan to take over the overseas market by introducing a lot of its desk lamps for study focusing on LED Stand at CES 2011.
Kim Seok-ho, a representative of Prism said "Lots of buyers are showing their interest. So we'll watch the interest at on-site and are going to participate to much more overseas exhibitions."
Prism is leading to pioneer overseas market exporting its products to USA and Brazil etc. starting with Japan.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
